- [FACT] User inquired about partnerships or collaborations Dartmouth College has formed with organizations outside of campus to promote sustainability in the surrounding community.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Dartmouth College has previously partnered with the town of Hanover, the Upper Valley Lake Sunapee Regional Planning Commission, and the Vermont Council on Rural Development to launch a sustainability initiative called "Hanover Smart Energy Challenge."
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Hanover Smart Energy Challenge aimed to engage residents in reducing energy consumption and promoting sustainable energy practices, including the use of renewable energy sources and reduced carbon emissions.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Dartmouth College has collaborated with the Upper Valley Land Trust and the National Fish and Wildlife Foundation to restore natural ecosystems and preserve local biodiversity.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Through the Land Trust's Land Link program, Dartmouth has facilitated the transfer of private lands into conservation easements to protect natural resources and biodiversity.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Dartmouth College has worked with organizations such as the Sustainable Forestry Initiative, Local Foods Plymouth, and the Sustainability Institute at Plymouth State University to promote sustainable land use practices and reduce the college's environmental footprint.
- [USER] Asked for more information about the Hanover Smart Energy Challenge, its impact on the community, and how success was measured.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Hanover Smart Energy Challenge was launched in 2016 to reduce energy consumption, promote sustainable energy practices, and reduce the carbon footprint of Hanover, New Hampshire.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The initiative aimed to engage residents, businesses, and community organizations in reducing energy consumption and promoting sustainable energy practices.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The challenge included competitions and events such as the "50-50 Challenge" and "Solarize Hanover."
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The "50-50 Challenge" encouraged Hanover residents and businesses to reduce their energy consumption by 50%.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] "Solarize Hanover" aimed to encourage the adoption of solar energy systems in the community.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Success was measured using metrics such as energy consumption data and feedback from community members.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The challenge exceeded its goal of reducing energy consumption by 5%, achieving a 6.95% reduction in town-wide energy consumption from 2015 to 2018.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The initiative helped promote sustainable practices and a culture of sustainability in the community, with many residents and businesses adopting sustainable energy practices during and after the challenge period.
